definitions.explanation: A heated room or facility used for bathing by sitting in dry heat or steam. Saunas have become extremely popular in Japan in recent years.

examples.english: I sweat it out in the sauna after work.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧サウナ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{水風呂|みずぶろ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: This hotel has a sauna and a cold plunge bath.

notes:
Sauna culture has seen a major revival in Japan, particularly since the early 2020s. The term サウナー (sauna enthusiast) is commonly used.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- サウナ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to go into a sauna
- サウナ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{整|ととの}う→整う：03935_totonou⟧: to achieve a state of relaxation through the sauna cycle
- {水風呂|みずぶろ}: cold plunge bath (used after sauna)
- {外気浴|がいきよく}: outdoor air bath (rest period in the sauna cycle)

USAGE:
The Japanese sauna experience typically follows a cycle: sauna → {水風呂|みずぶろ} (cold bath) → {外気浴|がいきよく} (rest). The verb ⟦{整|ととの}う→整う：03935_totonou⟧ (to be in order) is used to describe the pleasant sensation achieved through this cycle.
